def find_lines(grid, base, frac=.35):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
 rs=[r for r in range(h) if sum(x==base for x in grid[r]) <= frac*w]

def transform_try(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    base = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == base for v in grid[r]) <= .35*w]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == base for r in range(h)) <= .35*h]
    linefreq = collections.Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r in hr or c in vc) and grid[r][c] != base)
    line = linefreq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def row_marked(r): return any(grid[r][c] not in (base,line) for c in vc)
    def col_marked(c): return any(grid[r][c] not in (base,line) for r in hr)
    while len(hr)>2 and not row_marked(hr[0]): hr=hr[1:]
    while len(hr)>2 and not row_marked(hr[-1]): hr=hr[:-1]
    while len(vc)>2 and not col_marked(vc[0]): vc=vc[1:]
    while len(vc)>2 and not col_marked(vc[-1]): vc=vc[:-1]
    out=[[base for _ in range(len(vc)-1)] for __ in range(len(hr)-1)]
    for i in range(len(hr)-1):
      for j in range(len(vc)-1):
        a,b=hr[i],hr[i+1]; x,y=vc[j],vc[j+1]
        vals=(grid[a][x],grid[a][y],grid[b][x],grid[b][y])
        if vals[0] not in (base,line) and all(v==vals[0] for v in vals): out[i][j]=vals[0]
    return out
